question: Assume today is 2026-08-29. You know nothing published after this date. Estimate the number of people who moved between municipalities within Japan in August 2026 (Japanese and foreign residents combined), as first reported in the Statistics Bureau of Japan's monthly Report on Internal Migration in Japan Derived from the Basic Resident Registration.

target.what: Number of persons recorded in the Basic Resident Registration as moving from one municipality to another within Japan during August 2026, Japanese and foreign residents combined, as the first preliminary monthly figure in the Statistics Bureau of Japan's Report on Internal Migration in Japan Derived
target.publisher: Statistics Bureau of Japan, Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications
target.cadence: Monthly preliminary report, typically published around the end of the following month; later annual/final series may revise preliminary values
target.caveats: At the 2026-08-29 cutoff, August 2026 is still ongoing and the August monthly report has not yet been published, so the target is a forecast of an unpublished first-reported figure. The report counts administrative resident-registration moves, not necessarily deduplicated unique people; a person mov

candidates.hypothesis: The August 2026 first-reported total is best anchored by earlier August totals and the 2026 January-July trajectory. If the level and seasonal pattern are stable, August 2026 can be expressed as August 2025 adjusted by recent year-over-year movement and known population or foreign-share changes. The role is to provide the base level and seasonal shape, not to assume exact repetition.
candidates.data_to_find: Monthly total internal-migration counts for Japanese and foreign residents combined, August 2018-2025, and January-July 2026 from the Report on Internal Migration. If a combined table is not available, retrieve Japanese and foreign components for the same months. Also record definitions: intra-prefectural versus inter-prefectural moves, treatment of same-municipality moves and international moves, publication date, and preliminary versus revised status.

assumptions.name: August share of annual inter-municipal movers
assumptions.rationale: Annual total p1 implies a monthly average share of 1/12=8.33%. August is a summer/Obon moving month but not the March-April peak; a share slightly above average is plausible. The range covers 8.0-9.2% for monthly seasonality uncertainty.
assumptions.applies_when: Used with the 2024 annual combined total to estimate August 2026; assumes the August seasonal share is stable across years.
assumptions.falsified_by: Monthly data showing the August share outside 8.0-9.2% of annual inter-municipal moves.

assumptions.name: 2024-to-2026 combined annual level factor
assumptions.rationale: February 2026 first-reported combined total was almost flat year-on-year (p19-p21), with foreign movers up and Japanese down (p22-p25). Japanese population is declining while foreign population is rising (p35-p39), so a near-neutral level factor with a modest range is appropriate.
assumptions.applies_when: Scales the 2024 annual total to the 2026 August level; assumes no large national change in registration propensity.
assumptions.falsified_by: 2025/2026 annual or year-to-date data showing the combined mover level outside ±4% of 2024.

assumptions.name: August-to-February ratio of monthly inter-municipal movers
assumptions.rationale: p19 gives February 2026, a low winter month. August includes summer/Obon moving and is typically stronger. If February is near 6.8% of annual and August near 8.6%, the ratio is around 1.26. The range allows for flat or stronger August seasonality.
assumptions.applies_when: Used to scale the February 2026 first-reported total to August 2026; assumes the seasonal ratio is stable and Obon timing does not shift migration out of August.
assumptions.falsified_by: Historical monthly series showing the August/February ratio outside 1.14-1.38.

assumptions.falsified_by: Observed August Japanese mover counts implying a rate outside 0.29-0.38% of Japanese population.

assumptions.falsified_by: Monthly foreign mover data showing the August foreign rate outside 0.95-1.50% of foreign population.

assumptions.name: August 2024-to-August 2026 change factor for all-resident inter-municipal movers
assumptions.rationale: Recent annual totals (p1–p7) show only mild decline, and February 2026 total movers were nearly flat year-on-year (p19 with p21). Foreign growth should offset Japanese decline, so a two-year August factor near 1.0 is defensible with a wide range for trend and shock uncertainty.
assumptions.applies_when: p125 August 2024 is a valid seasonal anchor and no large August 2026 registration/disaster shock occurs.
assumptions.falsified_by: Published August 2025/2026 data showing a change materially outside ±5%, or evidence of a major registration-timing shift.

assumptions.name: Japanese August 2024-to-August 2026 change factor
assumptions.rationale: Japanese population fell 0.76% year-on-year (p37), Japanese February 2026 inter-municipal movers were down 1.5% (p22), and annual totals show mild decline. Two years of Japanese mobility decline point to a factor slightly below 1.0.
assumptions.applies_when: The recent Japanese mobility decline continues through August 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that Japanese inter-municipal movers rebounded or fell much faster than the recent trend.

assumptions.name: Foreign August 2024-to-August 2026 change factor
assumptions.rationale: Foreign movers were up 10.0% year-on-year in February 2026 (p23/p25) and 12.6% in October 2025 (p159/p164); foreign resident population rose 9.62% (p39). A two-year factor around 1.18 incorporates strong but possibly slowing foreign mobility growth.
assumptions.applies_when: Foreign resident mobility continues to grow at roughly the recent pace through August 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: A sharp slowdown or reversal in foreign mover counts or foreign resident growth.

assumptions.name: Japanese August 2026-to-February 2026 ratio of monthly inter-municipal movers
assumptions.rationale: p128 August 2024 Japanese movers is close to p22 February 2026 Japanese movers after allowing for Japanese decline; this implies August is seasonally near or slightly below February for Japanese movers. The total August/February comparison from p125 and p19 is also near parity.
assumptions.applies_when: The Japanese monthly seasonal pattern in 2026 resembles the limited observed August/February evidence.
assumptions.falsified_by: A large August 2026 Japanese seasonal deviation or a revised February 2026 base outside the range.

assumptions.name: Foreign August 2026-to-February 2026 ratio of monthly inter-municipal movers
assumptions.rationale: p131 August 2024 foreign movers and p23 February 2026 foreign movers, adjusted for foreign growth, suggest August foreign movement is modestly above February. Foreign seasonality is less stable, so the range is wide.
assumptions.applies_when: Foreign movers show the usual August uplift relative to February in 2026.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence of a flat or reversed foreign August/February seasonal pattern in 2026.

assumptions.name: Total August 2026-to-February 2026 ratio of monthly inter-municipal movers
assumptions.rationale: p125 August 2024 total and p19 February 2026 total are nearly equal, and the recent total trend is near flat with foreign growth offsetting Japanese decline. This makes an August/February total ratio centered near 1.0 reasonable.
assumptions.applies_when: Total August/February seasonality is stable and February 2026 is a valid near-term base.
assumptions.falsified_by: Published August or revised February data showing a large seasonal or level shift.

methods.label: m1

p125.role: August 2024 nationwide all-resident inter-municipal mover total, used as the observed August seasonal anchor

a1.role: change factor scaling August 2024 all-resident inter-municipal movers to August 2026

methods.rationale: Direct August-to-August transfer using the only observed August total before the cutoff. It preserves the August seasonal shape but must absorb two years of trend and any 2025/2026 shocks. Shared dependence: uses the same Statistics Bureau monthly definition and the 2024 August vintage.

methods.label: m2

a2.role: change factor scaling August 2024 Japanese movers to August 2026

a3.role: change factor scaling August 2024 foreign movers to August 2026

methods.rationale: Splits the target into Japanese and foreign components, each anchored on observed August 2024 component counts and scaled by separate trend factors. This captures the offsetting Japanese decline and foreign growth. Weakness: both components share the August 2024 vintage and the two-year factors are uncertain.

methods.label: m3

a4.role: August 2026-to-February 2026 seasonal ratio for Japanese inter-municipal movers

a5.role: August 2026-to-February 2026 seasonal ratio for foreign inter-municipal movers

methods.rationale: Uses the latest pre-cutoff February 2026 component levels and converts them to August with separate seasonal ratios. It is close in time to the target and retains component mix. Weakness: seasonal ratios are assumption-driven, and February 2026 preliminary values may be revised.

methods.label: m4

p19.role: February 2026 nationwide all-resident inter-municipal mover total

a6.role: August 2026-to-February 2026 seasonal ratio for total inter-municipal movers

methods.rationale: Simple latest-total seasonal transfer from February 2026 to August 2026. It is a check on the component routes and reuses the round-1 February-base route with an updated seasonal factor. Weakness: ignores changing Japanese/foreign composition and shares the same February 2026 base as m3.

kept.name: August 2024-to-August 2026 change factor for all-resident inter-municipal movers
kept.rationale: Recent annual totals (p1–p7) show only mild decline, and February 2026 total movers were nearly flat year-on-year (p19 with p21). Foreign growth should offset Japanese decline, so a two-year August factor near 1.0 is defensible with a wide range for trend and shock uncertainty.
kept.applies_when: p125 August 2024 is a valid seasonal anchor and no large August 2026 registration/disaster shock occurs.
kept.falsified_by: Published August 2025/2026 data showing a change materially outside ±5%, or evidence of a major registration-timing shift.

kept.name: Japanese August 2024-to-August 2026 change factor
kept.rationale: Japanese population fell 0.76% year-on-year (p37), Japanese February 2026 inter-municipal movers were down 1.5% (p22), and annual totals show mild decline. Two years of Japanese mobility decline point to a factor slightly below 1.0.
kept.applies_when: The recent Japanese mobility decline continues through August 2026.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that Japanese inter-municipal movers rebounded or fell much faster than the recent trend.

kept.name: Foreign August 2024-to-August 2026 change factor
kept.rationale: Foreign movers were up 10.0% year-on-year in February 2026 (p23/p25) and 12.6% in October 2025 (p159/p164); foreign resident population rose 9.62% (p39). A two-year factor around 1.18 incorporates strong but possibly slowing foreign mobility growth.
kept.applies_when: Foreign resident mobility continues to grow at roughly the recent pace through August 2026.
kept.falsified_by: A sharp slowdown or reversal in foreign mover counts or foreign resident growth.

kept.name: Japanese August 2026-to-February 2026 ratio of monthly inter-municipal movers
kept.rationale: p128 August 2024 Japanese movers is close to p22 February 2026 Japanese movers after allowing for Japanese decline; this implies August is seasonally near or slightly below February for Japanese movers. The total August/February comparison from p125 and p19 is also near parity.
kept.applies_when: The Japanese monthly seasonal pattern in 2026 resembles the limited observed August/February evidence.
kept.falsified_by: A large August 2026 Japanese seasonal deviation or a revised February 2026 base outside the range.

kept.name: Foreign August 2026-to-February 2026 ratio of monthly inter-municipal movers
kept.rationale: p131 August 2024 foreign movers and p23 February 2026 foreign movers, adjusted for foreign growth, suggest August foreign movement is modestly above February. Foreign seasonality is less stable, so the range is wide.
kept.applies_when: Foreign movers show the usual August uplift relative to February in 2026.

The best estimate is 355,831 person (80% model-based interval 240,336 to 526,826 person) for persons recorded in the Basic Resident Registration as moving between municipalities within Japan during August 2026, Japanese and foreign residents combined, as the first preliminary monthly figure.

Four routes were averaged with equal weights of 25% each: 355,293, 353,599, 356,146, and 358,300 person. Observed anchors include August 2024 totals (355,918 persons), August 2024 Japanese and foreign components (313,909 persons; 42,009 persons), and February 2026 levels (309,774 persons; 46,939 persons; 356,713 persons). The transfers to August 2026 rest on assumptions a1–a6, including Japanese and foreign change factors and seasonal ratios.

The main risk is that these two-year factors and seasonal ratios are unobserved and could absorb trend or shocks poorly. The most useful missing evidence would be a published August 2025 figure to calibrate the August seasonal shape.

Key assumptions (proposed by the analyst model, not observed; code samples each one between the bounds shown):
- a1 August 2024-to-August 2026 change factor for all-resident inter-municipal movers: 1 factor, range 0.8933 to 1.117 (range widened by code); used by m1. Overturned by: Published August 2025/2026 data showing a change materially outside ±[n], or evidence of a major registration-timing shift.
- a2 Japanese August 2024-to-August 2026 change factor: 0.97 factor, range 0.8626 to 1.078 (range widened by code); used by m2. Overturned by: Evidence that Japanese inter-municipal movers rebounded or fell much faster than the recent trend.
- a3 Foreign August 2024-to-August 2026 change factor: 1.18 factor, range 1.061 to 1.327 (range widened by code); used by m2. Overturned by: A sharp slowdown or reversal in foreign mover counts or foreign resident growth.
- a4 Japanese August 2026-to-February 2026 ratio of monthly inter-municipal movers: 0.98 ratio, range 0.6924 to 1.385 (range widened by code); used by m3. Overturned by: A large August 2026 Japanese seasonal deviation or a revised February 2026 base outside the range.
- a5 Foreign August 2026-to-February 2026 ratio of monthly inter-municipal movers: 1.08 ratio, range 0.7616 to 1.523 (range widened by code); used by m3. Overturned by: Evidence of a flat or reversed foreign August/February seasonal pattern in 2026.
- a6 Total August 2026-to-February 2026 ratio of monthly inter-municipal movers: 1 ratio, range 0.7058 to 1.412 (range widened by code); used by m4. Overturned by: Published August or revised February data showing a large seasonal or level shift.

by_construction: Only URLs leave the searcher (code regex); extractor, judge and final prompts never contain search result titles, snippets or the searcher's text. This holds by construction and is not measured.
residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
